notice: Reviewed public-context evidence pack for the retrieve_context tool. Facts are generic public background from official sources; approximate figures are marked approximate. This pack contains no operational data for the synthetic scenario.

facts.fact: PSA International operates a global network of port terminals and supply chain facilities across dozens of countries, with its flagship operations in Singapore.
facts.source_title: PSA International Annual and Sustainability Report 2025

facts.fact: The Port of Singapore is one of the world's largest container transshipment hubs, where a large majority of containers handled arrive on one vessel and depart on another.
facts.source_title: PSA International Annual and Sustainability Report 2025

facts.fact: Singapore's container throughput is on the order of 40 million TEUs (twenty-foot equivalent units) per year (approximate).
Singapore's total port cargo throughput is on the order of 600 million tonnes per year (approximate).
The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) publishes monthly vessel arrival statistics, reflecting a continuous flow of tens of thousands of vessel calls per year (approximate).
Singapore is connected by liner shipping services to several hundred ports worldwide, which is why a single inbound delay can affect many onward connections (approximate).
facts.source_title: PSA International Annual and Sustainability Report 2025

facts.fact: PSA Singapore is progressively consolidating container operations at Tuas Port, which is planned to handle up to about 65 million TEUs per year when fully developed (approximate).
PSA Singapore reports on energy efficiency and electrification of port equipment as part of its sustainability program, including powering refrigerated containers at the yard.
UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations) assigns the code SGSIN to the Port of Singapore.
UN/LOCODE provides standardized five-character location codes used across shipping documents and port systems to identify ports and other transport locations.
